name: swap
title: Swap
description: A plus tile flips aside to reveal a minus tile beneath, then flips back on top. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `Swap`. Import it from `@/components/ui/swap` and render `<Swap key={run} aria-label="A plus tile and a minus tile swapping places" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--swap-surface`, `--swap-front`, `--swap-front-ink`, `--swap-back`, `--swap-back-ink`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: opacity only. The plus fades out to show the minus, then fades back in.
